EMGPlacementSchemeDescription: Surface EMG electrode placement on wrist/forearm devices; exact anatomical coordinates are not provided in the public release.
TaskDescription: Surface EMG recordings paired with hand-pose joint angles for the emg2pose benchmark.
Instructions: Participants performed the hand-movement stage named in the Stage field; exact participant instructions are not provided in the public release.

EMG high-pass and rescaling.Description: Upstream emg2pose release high-pass filtered the sEMG at 40 Hz and rescaled it so the noise floor has a standard deviation of one.

Joint-angle low-pass filter.Description: Motion-capture inverse-kinematics joint angles were low-pass filtered at 15 Hz and upsampled to 2 kHz in the upstream release.

ElectrodeManufacturersModelName: sEMG-RD dry gold-plated differential electrode pair
SEMGRDDescription: sEMG-RD wrist bands with 16 differential electrode pairs arranged on a rigid ribbon, one band per wrist.
MotionCaptureDescription: Joint-angle labels were derived from 19 markers per hand tracked by a 26-camera OptiTrack/Motive2 setup and solved with an offline inverse-kinematics pipeline.
